mappings.coverage: Whole bounded target/depth restore consumer over shared backend, real target cache and complete original viewport refresh; final COM edges explicit.
limitations: Original6e33a0/6e3650/6e2880/6e2510 and viewport setters/reset/forwarders/CRT run unchanged over one fixed backend29765c8. No intermediate helper or arithmetic adapters.
Restore selects initial flag branch once, then rereads capabilities and target cache gates per extra slot. Active handle is reread after initial target callback.
Clear-additional rereads signed configuration, current flag and ushort count per slot. Changed cache cells zero before direct COM; opaque HRESULT never causes rollback.

Depth target always forwarded after target calls; fresh backend dimensions then populate screen/origin globals and feed actual context refresh. Both callers tail-jump to actual refresh and return its final raw word.
